description: Runs a ready-made app published on Quay.io as a live jengakit app, from its quay.io name. No source code needed.
author: jengakit

ui.description: Runs a ready-made app published on Quay.io, with no source code needed. The app's web port is found for you.

sample_prompts: Import a Quay.io container image into jengaKIT
Deploy a Red Hat Quay image as a jengaKIT app

user_inputs.label: Quay.io Username
user_inputs.hint: Required only for private images. Leave blank for public Quay.io images.

user_inputs.label: Quay.io Token / Robot Account
user_inputs.hint: Robot account token from quay.io → Account Settings → Robot Accounts.
